client_letter.subject: Your Policy Renewal Details
client_letter.body:
Dear Derek P Halstead Construction Co Inc,

Your Contractors Special Policy will renew on September 24, 2026, and your premium remains the same at $1,879.

Here are the key changes in your coverage:

- The CP 382 — NY Anti Arson Amendment has been removed from the policy.
- The DNCANY — Important Notice Exclusion - Communicable Disease has also been removed.

We are currently confirming with the insurer whether these exclusions were removed intentionally and for what reasons.

Additionally, we recommend considering communicable disease coverage due to its exclusion in your current policy.

Please feel free to contact us if you have any questions or need further discussion on these changes.

Best regards,
Account Manager (demo)
Fideon Demo Agency
